business_summary: Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides financial services in Hong Kong. It operates through: Securities Broking, and Futures and Commodities Broking segments. The company offers broking services in traded securities, commodities, and future contracts; margin and IPO financing; leveraged foreign exchange trading; forex trading; bullion dealing and bullion trading; investment fund; administrative; and asset management services. It also engages in the production and broadcast of finance programs. Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. As of March 30, 2026, Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited is a subsidiary of Wealthiness and Prosperity Holding Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited는 홍콩에서 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 증권 중개, 선물 및 상품 중개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 거래되는 증권, 상품 및 미래 계약에 대한 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 마진 및 IPO 자금조달; 레버리지 외환 거래; 외환 거래; 금괴 거래 및 금괴 거래; 투자 기금; 행정; 및 자산 관리 서비스. 또한 금융 프로그램 제작 및 방송에도 참여하고 있습니다. Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited는 1995년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 2026년 3월 30일 현재 Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited는 Wealthiness and Prosperity Holding Limited의 자회사입니다.
